description:
Create a pending order with one or more actions. Returns order details with pricing and gas estimates. Order expires after 5 minutes.

Params: actions (array of {type, params}), session_token (string), idempotency_key (string?)
Returns: {order_id, summary, total_cost, gas_estimates, expires_at, idempotency_key}
Errors: NO_SESSION, SESSION_EXPIRED, INVALID_ACTIONS, VALIDATION_ERROR

actions.description: Array of order actions to execute

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

name: create_order
title: Create an order
